newsitem.title: USA: General Scanning adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: General Scanning adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: WATERTOWN, Mass., May 1 (Reuter) General Scanning Inc said Thursday it declared a special dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right for each outstanding share of General Scanning common stock, payable May 1 to stockholders of record that day.

The company said the distribution is intended to protect shareholder interests in the event of an unsolicited merger or acquisition and would kick in when anyone acquires 20 percent or more of the company's common shares.
The rights will expire on May 1, 2007, unless redeemed prior to that date.
General Scanning develops and manufactures a broad line of laser systems for a wide range of applications in the semiconductor, electronics, aircraft and medical industries.
